component.name: QtEdit
component.summary: A small, fast Qt 6 text editor

description.p: QtEdit is a lightweight text editor built with Qt 6 and C++. It is designed to stay out of the way while providing the features needed for everyday editing and programming.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting for C/C++, Python, JSON, and shell scripts
Find bar with match case, highlight-all, and wrap-around search
Auto-indent, brace dedent, and spaces-based tab indentation
Configurable font, zoom, word wrap, and full-screen mode
Recent files, go-to-line, and drag-and-drop file opening
